name: arisa-restart
description: Safely restart the active Arisa background service through an independent detached worker, with exact PID identity checks, stable IPC verification, and automatic start recovery.

handoffDelayMs.prompt: Milliseconds the detached worker waits before stopping Arisa so the initiating reply can finish.

stopTimeoutMs.prompt: Maximum time to wait for the old Arisa service to stop.

startTimeoutMs.prompt: Maximum time allowed for the Arisa start command.

verifyTimeoutMs.prompt: Maximum time to wait for the restarted service to become healthy.

stabilityWindowMs.prompt: Continuous healthy time required before the restart is accepted.

notifyOnCompletion.prompt: Queue an agent event after restart completion or failure.
